description: resilience.py provides a retry decorator. Its docstring states that ``times`` is the total number of attempts, but the loop currently runs one attempt fewer than requested, so retry(times=1) never calls the function at all and retry(times=3) only makes two attempts. Fix the loop, preserve the behaviour that the last exception is re-raised when all attempts fail, and keep non-matching exceptions propagating immediately.
expected_behavior: A function failing twice then succeeding succeeds under times=3 and is called 3 times. A function always raising is called exactly times times and the original exception type is raised.
notes: Synthetic defect seeded for the VerifyLoop benchmark. Not a production incident.
title: Retry decorator performs one attempt too few
